content:
Hi everyone, I’m Leo, a first-year PhD student in algebra at Southern University of Science and Technology.

My research interests are Jordan algebras and representation theory, and my advisors are Prof. Vyacheslav Futorny and Prof. Iryna Kashuba. (I also learn from Prof. Efim Zelmanov)

I joined this community for two main reasons. First, as a beginner, I would like to learn Lean 4 systematically. I am very interested in formalized mathematics, and I believe it is one of the most important directions in the future development of mathematics. Second, I noticed that mathlib currently has very little material related to Jordan algebras, and I hope to contribute to this area in the future.

I’m very happy to be here and look forward to learning from the community.

My respect and greetings to everyone in the community!
Hi Leo, welcome! Nice to see a fellow SUSTech student here. I’m also at SUSTech. Looking forward to learning together!
